description: Aura Phase-H = masterplan Phase 10 (Single Source of Truth Config). Move ALL config to SQLite; eliminate .env as a runtime input. Per .planning/deep-refactor/Phase10_Single_Source_Of_Truth_Config/plan.md + prd.md §6 Phase 10. Current state: .env.example already declares 'Most configuration now lives in the dashboard's Settings page, persisted to aura.db' but 15 keys (secrets + bootstrap meta-config) still need .env. Goal: secrets table in SQLite, boot reads from SQLite, setup wizard writes SQLite, existing installs migrate .env -> SQLite transparently on first post-upgrade boot, then operator can delete .env. Each story = ONE atomic commit on master.

userStories.title: Add `secrets` table + repo (migration v9)
userStories.description: Create the SQLite storage foundation for Aura secrets, separate from the existing `settings` table so the privacy boundary is explicit. (a) New migration in internal/db/migrations/migrations.go: Version 9, Name 'add_secrets_table'. Schema: CREATE TABLE secrets ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL ). Same shape as the existing `settings` table on purpose — same code path semantics, just a different table so SELECT against `settings` never accidentally exposes a secret. (b) New file internal/secrets/store.go (or internal/storage/secrets/) with a Store struct + interface: Get(ctx, key) (value string, err error), Set(ctx, key, value string) error, Delete(ctx, key) error, List(ctx) ([]string, error) — List returns KEYS ONLY, never values (logs/dashboard need to enumerate without leaking). Reader-side returns ErrSecretNotFound (typed) when missing. (c) Define the canonical secret keys as exported constants: KeyTelegramToken, KeyLLMAPIKey, KeyEmbeddingAPIKey, KeyGarageS3AccessKey, KeyGarageS3SecretKey, KeyQdrantAPIKey. (d) Test: migration applies cleanly on a fresh DB and a v8 DB; Store roundtrip (Set -> Get returns value, Delete -> Get returns ErrSecretNotFound, List returns keys but never values); concurrent Set/Get is safe (uses the same sql.DB pool the rest of the storage layer uses). NO callers wired yet — this is foundation. NO logging of values anywhere.

userStories.title: One-shot .env -> SQLite migration helper
userStories.description: Existing installs have secrets in .env. On first post-upgrade boot we must import them to SQLite before the boot loader (US-H03) starts reading from SQLite, otherwise upgrade is a breaking change. (a) New function internal/secrets/migrate.go (or similar): ImportFromDotEnv(ctx, store secrets.Store, dotenvPath, logger) (imported []string, err error). Returns the list of KEYS imported (no values). Idempotent: if a key is already present in the store (set previously), skip — do NOT overwrite. The legacy .env is the LOSER on conflict. (b) Reads .env via the existing cmd/aura/main.go::loadDotEnv parser (or its exported equivalent — extract if needed). (c) Maps env-var names to canonical secret keys: TELEGRAM_TOKEN -> KeyTelegramToken, LLM_API_KEY -> KeyLLMAPIKey, EMBEDDING_API_KEY -> KeyEmbeddingAPIKey, GARAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY -> KeyGarageS3AccessKey, GARAGE_S3_SECRET_KEY -> KeyGarageS3SecretKey, QDRANT_API_KEY -> KeyQdrantAPIKey. Unknown env keys are SKIPPED (no error). (d) Empty values are skipped (env stub like TELEGRAM_TOKEN= must not pollute SQLite with empty strings). (e) Logger emits Info with the KEY names imported (never values) and a count summary. (f) Tests: migrate from a .env with all secrets present -> all keys imported; second run is no-op (already present); empty values skipped; missing .env file returns ([], nil) not error; values containing quotes survive roundtrip exactly (telebot tokens contain ':' and other punctuation).

userStories.notes: MUST land BEFORE US-H03 (boot reads from SQLite). Otherwise existing installs break because their secrets are still in .env, not in SQLite, and the boot loader can't find them. Order is non-negotiable.

userStories.title: Boot loader reads secrets from SQLite (post-migration)
userStories.description: Switch the boot path so secrets come from SQLite, not env vars. (a) cmd/aura/main.go (or wherever bootstrap lives): after `db.Open()` succeeds and migrations applied, call secrets.ImportFromDotEnv (US-H02 helper) to migrate any legacy .env values — this runs every boot but is idempotent, so it only does work on the first post-upgrade boot. (b) Then construct the secrets.Store and read each secret key with store.Get; populate cfg.TelegramToken, cfg.LLMAPIKey, cfg.EmbeddingAPIKey, cfg.GarageS3AccessKey, cfg.GarageS3SecretKey, cfg.QdrantAPIKey FROM the store, NOT from `getSecretEnv(...)`. (c) If TelegramToken is empty after SQLite read, fall through to the existing first-run setup wizard exactly as today (the wizard switch in US-H04 will redirect its write target to SQLite). (d) DO NOT remove `getSecretEnv` calls in this story — leave them as last-resort fallback for operators who explicitly set env vars (containers with secret managers). The precedence becomes: SQLite secrets table > env var > empty. (e) Tests: cmd/aura test harness that boots with a stub Store + stub env -> cfg fields populated from store; with empty store + env vars present -> cfg fields populated from env (back-compat); with both -> SQLite wins.

userStories.title: Setup wizard writes secrets to SQLite
userStories.description: First-run setup wizard currently calls writeDotEnvKey (internal/api/setup_dotenv.go) to write TELEGRAM_TOKEN, LLM_API_KEY, etc. into .env. Switch its target to the SQLite secrets store. (a) internal/api/setup_dotenv.go: rename / refactor the writeDotEnvKey contract. The cleanest path is to add a parallel writeSecret(store secrets.Store, key, value string) error and migrate every caller of writeDotEnvKey that targets a secret-shaped key to use it. (b) Identify the secret-shaped keys among current writeDotEnvKey callers in internal/api/setup_*.go (TELEGRAM_TOKEN definitely; LLM_API_KEY if present; EMBEDDING_API_KEY likewise; etc.). Non-secret keys (DB_PATH, HTTP_PORT, AURA_TIMEZONE — actually those are bootstrap meta and US-H05 handles them) STAY as writeDotEnvKey IF still needed; ideally those are not written by the wizard at all (defaults in code). (c) The wizard's HTTP handlers in setup_server.go that drive the form submission now call writeSecret for token + API keys, and writeDotEnvKey ONLY for the few bootstrap meta-config keys that genuinely need to survive without SQLite. (d) Tests in setup_setup_test.go: wizard submission populates secrets.Store with the right keys; .env (if the test temp-dir uses one) does NOT contain TELEGRAM_TOKEN after submission.

userStories.title: Hardcode bootstrap meta-config with env override fallback
userStories.description: Bootstrap meta-config (DB_PATH, HTTP_PORT, AURA_HEADLESS, AURA_TIMEZONE, AURA_ENV_PATH) is needed BEFORE SQLite is open. Today these come from .env. After Phase 10 they should have hardcoded sensible defaults so a brand-new install needs NO .env file at all; operators can still override via env var when needed. (a) cmd/aura/main.go bootstrap: set DB_PATH default to './aura.db' (or container-aware './data/aura.db' if AURA_HEADLESS path detected), HTTP_PORT to '127.0.0.1:8080', AURA_HEADLESS to auto-detect (false on TTY, true otherwise), AURA_TIMEZONE to OS detection (empty = use OS local). (b) Read os.Getenv for each — if set non-empty, use the env value; else use the hardcoded default. (c) AURA_ENV_PATH becomes a no-op: the loader still calls loadDotEnv if .env exists (for back-compat — US-H02 still imports it once), but never WRITES a fresh .env. (d) Tests: cmd/aura boot with no env vars + no .env -> uses all hardcoded defaults; with DB_PATH=/tmp/foo.db env override -> opens /tmp/foo.db; with HTTP_PORT=:9999 -> binds :9999.
